en: One who, having once submerged, remains submerged; one who, having emerged, submerges again; one who, having emerged, stands [there]; one who, having emerged...
He sees with insight, he surveys; having emerged, he crosses over; having emerged, he has reached a firm footing;
having emerged, he has crossed over, gone to the further shore, and stands on dry land—the brahmin.
[These are: one liberated both ways, one liberated by wisdom, a body-witness, one attained to view, one liberated by faith, a follower of the Dhamma, and a follower by faith.
